prompts.hero: Use case: product-mockup. Create an original premium editorial 3D hero image for MiskatDesigns, an Italian web design studio. Wide landscape composition 3:2. A beautifully crafted slim silver desktop monitor, matching laptop and small upright smartphone arranged at different heights on a sculptural pale blue plinth. Devices show cohesive sophisticated web design with dark navy typography, generous white space, cobalt blue sections and pale mint photographic-looking abstract architectural imagery. On the largest screen only readable headline is 'Il tuo valore, online.' Small brand 'MiskatDesigns'. Other UI text minimal, no fake metrics. Background seamless soft ice-blue studio, very subtle light gradient, soft daylight shadows, brushed aluminum and realistic glass, premium industrial design photography. Composition centered with generous space around all device edges, all devices fully in frame, monitor highest rear center, laptop front left and phone front right. High-end photorealistic 3D, restrained and clean, no humans, no third-party logos, no watermark, no outer headings or captions.

Isometric three-quarter camera, beautiful tactile realistic materials, crisp geometry, soft directional studio lighting. Entire object grouping on RIGHT TWO THIRDS, LEFT THIRD clean negative space. Uniform very light cool grey-white background #f3f5f8, subtle contact shadows, all objects comfortably inside image, no text, no logos, no watermark. Sophisticated product render, not cartoon, no busy decorations.
